topic.title: Anomaly Detection with Limited and Imperfect Supervision
topic.overview: Anomaly detection identifies observations that depart from expected behavior when unusual cases are rare, diverse, or unlabeled. Representatives learn normal-data distributions, compact one-class representations, and boundaries informed by a few labeled anomalies. Contaminated training sets complicate the task because the learner must decide which examples should define normality.
topic.whyItMatters: A detector that recognizes only previously labeled failures can miss the events that matter most. Reliable methods need to separate genuine deviations from benign distribution changes and quantify the cost of false alarms.
topic.evolution: Early examples monitor faults in dynamic systems and industrial machinery. Deep one-class and multiple-hypothesis methods appear later, followed by joint inference of contamination labels and recent pretrained or graph-based detectors. The recurring question is how to exploit partial supervision without narrowing the detector to familiar anomaly types.
openQuestions: How can a detector adapt to changing normal behavior without absorbing real faults?
When do labeled anomalies improve recognition of different, unseen failures?

papers.title: NOVA: A Benchmark for Rare Anomaly Localization and Clinical Reasoning in Brain MRI
papers.tldr: NOVA uses roughly 900 brain MRI scans spanning 281 rare pathologies to expose substantial vision-language-model gaps in localization and clinical reasoning.

papers.title: On the SAC-BL Algorithm for Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: SAC-SBL randomizes SAC-BL's decision rule to improve false positive rates while preserving false discovery rate control.

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution Generalized Graph Anomaly Detection with Homophily-aware Environment Mixup
papers.tldr: HEM separates feature and neighborhood learning and generates varied graph environments to improve anomaly detection under structural shifts.

papers.title: PANDA: Towards Generalist Video Anomaly Detection via Agentic AI Engineer
papers.tldr: PANDA combines retrieval, planning, reflection, tools, and memory for video anomaly detection across varied settings without task-specific training.

papers.title: PhysDiff: A Physically-Guided Diffusion Model for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: PhysDiff guides diffusion reconstruction with adaptive frequency components to improve time-series anomaly detection and interpretation.

papers.title: Quantifying Statistical Significance of Deep Nearest Neighbor Anomaly Detection via Selective Inference
papers.tldr: Selective inference supplies p-values for deep nearest-neighbor anomaly detections, enabling false-positive control while accounting for data-driven selection.

papers.title: ReinAD: Towards Real-world Industrial Anomaly Detection with a Comprehensive Contrastive Dataset
papers.tldr: ReinAD pairs production-line inspection data with a reference-comparison model that handles fine-grained defects and image misalignment.

papers.title: Scalable, Explainable and Provably Robust Anomaly Detection with One-Step Flow Matching
papers.tldr: TCCM detects tabular anomalies in one forward pass using contraction deviations, with feature-level attribution and small-perturbation stability guarantees.

papers.title: ScatterAD: Temporal-Topological Scattering Mechanism for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: ScatterAD combines temporal and graph-based representation scattering to improve multivariate time-series anomaly detection on public benchmarks.

papers.title: Self-Perturbed Anomaly-Aware Graph Dynamics for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: SPAGD uses self-perturbed sequences and dynamically adjusted variable relationships to improve multivariate time-series anomaly detection.

papers.title: Semi-supervised Graph Anomaly Detection via Robust Homophily Learning
papers.tldr: RHO improves graph anomaly detection by learning diverse normal-node similarity patterns and aligning complementary views of those patterns.

papers.title: Structured Temporal Causality for Interpretable Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: OracleAD combines prediction errors with deviations from learned normal relationships to detect time-series anomalies and identify implicated variables.

papers.title: Unifying Reconstruction and Density Estimation via Invertible Contraction Mapping in One-Class Classification
papers.tldr: The framework combines contraction-guided reconstruction and density estimation to detect anomalies using training data containing only normal examples.

papers.title: VADTree: Explainable Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Tree
papers.tldr: VADTree organizes video into an adaptive hierarchy of events to improve training-free anomaly detection while sampling fewer segments.

papers.title: Anomaly-Preference Image Generation
papers.tldr: APO learns from real anomaly references and allocates diffusion capacity across noise levels to improve generated anomalies’ realism and diversity.

papers.title: AnomSeer: Reinforcing Multimodal LLMs to Reason for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: AnomSeer trains multimodal models with structural time-series reasoning signals to improve anomaly classification, localization, and supporting explanations.

papers.title: Causal-aware Anomaly Detection for Tabular Data
papers.tldr: CausalAno detects tabular anomalies through representations of normal causal mechanisms, improving results across continuous and mixed-type datasets.

papers.title: Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer for Online Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
papers.tldr: A cluster-aware causal mixer combines channel grouping with sequential evidence accumulation to improve online time-series anomaly detection.

papers.title: COGNOS: Universal Enhancement for Time Series Anomaly Detection via Constrained Gaussian-Noise Optimization and Smoothing
papers.tldr: COGNOS improves reconstruction-based anomaly detection by shaping residual statistics during training and adaptively smoothing anomaly scores.

papers.title: Counterfactual Occlusion-Aware Learning via Visibility Intervention for LiDAR Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: COVAL improves LiDAR anomaly detection by training on paired visibility changes that reveal how anomalies affect both observed points and occluded regions.

papers.title: Denoising without Diffusion: Fixed-Noise Denoiser Anomaly Detection in Tabular Data
papers.tldr: A fixed-noise denoiser detects tabular anomalies through perturbation stability and outperforms existing baselines on ADBench.

papers.title: $f$-Divergence Self-Play for Tabular Anomaly Detection via Large Language Models
papers.tldr: DiSPaT uses alternating generation and discrimination to improve an LLM’s model of normal table rows and detect anomalies.

papers.title: Formally Exploring Visual Anomaly Detection Evaluation Metrics
papers.tldr: SAAM-ALARM evaluates visual anomaly detection using explicit properties that capture errors overlooked by existing metrics.

papers.title: Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Prototype-Based Distillation
papers.tldr: ProMoS distills normal graph patterns into prototype-aligned students for label-free anomaly detection on unseen graphs.

papers.title: IMPACT: Influence Modeling for Open-Set Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: IMPACT uses training-sample influence to generate realistic unseen time-series anomalies and address unlabeled anomaly contamination.

papers.title: Is Task-Specific Training Necessary for Anomaly Detection?
papers.tldr: RAD detects anomalies by retrieving normal reference features, achieving leading reported results without task-specific training.

papers.title: Learning Discriminative and Generalizable Anomaly Detector for Dynamic Graph with Limited Supervision
papers.tldr: A model-agnostic framework combines temporal residuals and likelihood-based boundaries to detect dynamic-graph anomalies with limited supervision.

papers.title: Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization for Video Anomaly Reasoning
papers.tldr: LRPO improves video anomaly reasoning without parameter updates by distilling comparative reasoning experience into contextual language guidance.

papers.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness
papers.tldr: Detecting injected internal concepts involves distributed anomaly-processing mechanisms, and targeted interventions improve the measured capability.

papers.title: Memory-Distilled Selection for Noise-Robust Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: MeDS combines subsampled memories, score distillation, and data filtering to detect industrial defects despite contaminated training data.

papers.title: Mixture Prototype Flow Matching for Open-Set Supervised Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: MPFM preserves distinct normal-data modes through Gaussian mixture flow matching to improve detection of unseen anomalies.

papers.title: Modeling Spectral Energy Shifts in Spatio-Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: The method detects camouflaged graph anomalies by modeling spectral energy shifts that existing increased-variation approaches overlook.

papers.title: MPFM: Cross Multi-Domain Prototype Flow Matching for Log Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: MPFM improves multi-domain log anomaly detection by combining shared and domain-specific prototypes with generation-based structural and dynamical evidence.

papers.title: MV-FGAD: Towards Efficient and Effective Federated Graph Anomaly Detection via Multi-view Learning
papers.tldr: MV-FGAD combines federated knowledge sharing and multiple anomaly views to detect weak and strong irregularities in distributed graphs.

papers.title: Noise-Robust Density Estimation for Tabular Data Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: NRDE separates estimated data and noise sources to base tabular anomaly detection on the density of underlying pure data.

papers.title: Normality Calibration in Semi-supervised Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: GraphNC improves graph anomaly detectors by calibrating teacher scores with unlabeled data and stabilizing representations of labeled normal nodes.

papers.title: PRISM: Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Intrinsic Statistical Modeling
papers.tldr: PRISM uses statistical background suppression in pretrained embeddings to support real-time, training-free video anomaly detection.

papers.title: Reliable Neighborhood-Aware Multi-View Outlier Detection
papers.tldr: RNAMOD combines reliable neighborhoods with scale-invariant directional alignment to improve multi-view outlier detection.

papers.title: Rethinking Feature Alignment in Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection: A Relational Fingerprint-based Approach
papers.tldr: REFI-GAD uses context-and-structure fingerprints to transfer anomaly-detection knowledge across graphs with heterogeneous features.

papers.title: Theoretical Investigation on Inductive Bias of Isolation Forest
papers.tldr: A random-walk analysis shows that Isolation Forest scores reflect both density and centrality, explaining reduced sensitivity to central anomalies.

papers.title: Towards Foundation Models for Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection: Leveraging Synthetic Data and Relative Context Discrepancy
papers.tldr: TimeRCD learns contextual anomaly judgments from synthetic data and performs strongly across most tested zero-shot time-series detection settings.

papers.title: Towards One-for-All Anomaly Detection for Tabular Data
papers.tldr: OFA-TAD learns transferable neighbor-distance patterns to detect anomalies in unseen tabular datasets without dataset-specific training.

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Video Anomaly Understanding: A Class-Guided Chain-of-Evaluation Metric and An Anomaly-focused Meta-Benchmark
papers.tldr: CG-CoE evaluates anomaly-event meaning, and a companion meta-benchmark tests whether scores remain valid and robust to stylistic changes.

papers.title: Tuning-Free One-Class Discriminant Learning for Tabular Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: DVM-AD combines compact and structure-preserving representations in a closed-form anomaly detector that requires no dataset-specific tuning.
